positive: deepest physical-EDT voxel of HU >= -400 component nearest box centre, restricted to the box (hero-crop64-v1 seed)
box: NLST: Farina-assisted tracked detector box. LIDC: best-scoring detector box within 10 mm of the reader-consensus centroid; else consensus bbox (seed_source=reference, segmentation-only evaluation)
crop: ceil(side / spacing) voxels per axis centred on box centre (+jitter); start floor(c - n/2); clipped to image; no padding/rescaling
masked: original grid; HU outside the crop64 index block set to -1000
trim: drop N low-index voxels per axis (affine shifted); restored by index paste
decode: point-only label == 1; class prompt label == 23 (also 1 accepted, recorded)
reference: LIDC consensus = voxels in >= ceil(R/2) of R reader masks
gates: crop64 technical gates from hero-crop64-v1 (extent <= 3x largest box axis, volume <= 4x box volume, contains positive, crop edge >= 5 mm)
